case_role: redundancy: Lebanon is related to South Governorate but has wrong query granularity; dependency pushes it far down

graph_semantics.kg_edges: Observed triples from train/valid/test around query/candidate seeds; intended for drawing the local KG neighborhood.
graph_semantics.prediction_edges: Candidate answer edges for the query, annotated with before/after ranks and scores.
graph_semantics.rule_dependency_layer: Top active rule/dependency identifiers and weights from the aggregation explanation. Full grounding witnesses were not saved by the application files, so this layer annotates candidates rather than claiming each rule edge is an observed KG edge.
